definition: **Industry** under industrial law is wider than a mere trade or business: it covers any systematic activity organised by cooperation between employer and employees for production/supply of goods or services — whether profit-making or not. The **Bangalore Water Supply** line of cases expanded "industry" to hospitals, educational institutions, charities, etc., subject to exceptions (small clubs, casual hobbies, sovereign functions in narrow sense).

statutoryReferences.note: Compare with pre-code ID Act definition in case law

cases.name: Bangalore Water Supply & Sewerage Board v. A. Rajappa
cases.proposition: Broad "triple test" — systematic activity, cooperation of employer and employees, production of goods/services; liberal definition unless specifically excluded.
